The '''MK. VIII''' was one of the most popular [[vibrosaw]]s produced by [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It could be used as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] but was difficult to handle.<ref name="ETU" />
